correctness.rationale: For missing root edge ab in L(K_n), outside selected-neighborhood size is d_H(a)+d_H(b); a fort fails iff there are root degrees 0 and 1. From this equivalent test, inclusion-minimal non-spanning forts are exactly proper cycles, while spanning ones are minimal edge covers, exactly spanning star forests. Inclusion-exclusion of degree-one vertices and isolates yields the full polynomial. Exponential component counting plus proper cycles yields the minimal-fort polynomial. Bounds on star-forest component counts prove the stated factorial asymptotic. The included direct-neighborhood full-subset verifier checks n=2..7; it does not by itself establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact enumeration of the entire ordinary-fort obstruction family of the canonical triangular/Johnson J(n,2) graphs, including a structural all-minimal-forts classification and its labeled generating polynomial. It provides a closed counting spectrum and factorial growth, rather than a renamed textbook parameter, tiny finite improvement, or already known minimum size. These descriptions can support fort-transversal zero-forcing optimization.
